question: 数据库里一共有多少个商品？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products

question: 最近30天耳机品类GMV是多少？
expected_sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT MAX(order_date)::date AS as_of_date FROM orders) SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = '耳机' AND o.order_date >= c.as_of_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND o.order_date < c.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day'

question: 最近30天各商品品类的GMV分别是多少？
expected_sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT MAX(order_date)::date AS as_of_date FROM orders) SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= c.as_of_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND o.order_date < c.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY p.category

question: 最近30天耳机品类访客量和转化率是多少？
expected_sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT MAX(date) AS as_of_date FROM traffic_daily) SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS visitors, ROUND(SUM(t.conversions)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(t.visitors), 0) * 100, 4) AS conversion_rate_pct FROM traffic_daily t JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.id CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE p.category = '耳机' AND t.date >= c.as_of_date - 29 AND t.date <= c.as_of_date

question: 最近30天耳机品类一共有多少笔退款？
expected_sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT MAX(created_at)::date AS as_of_date FROM refunds) SELECT COUNT(r.id) AS refund_count FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE p.category = '耳机' AND r.created_at >= c.as_of_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND r.created_at < c.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day'

question: 最近30天耳机品类退款金额是多少？
expected_sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT MAX(created_at)::date AS as_of_date FROM refunds) SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE p.category = '耳机' AND r.created_at >= c.as_of_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND r.created_at < c.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day'

question: 分别给我最近30天和前30天耳机品类的GMV
expected_sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT MAX(order_date)::date AS as_of_date FROM orders) SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_date >= c.as_of_date - INTERVAL '29 days' THEN '最近30天' ELSE '前30天' END AS period, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = '耳机' AND o.order_date >= c.as_of_date - INTERVAL '59 days' AND o.order_date < c.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY period

question: 最近30天耳机品类的平均订单金额是多少？
expected_sql: WITH clock AS (SELECT MAX(order_date)::date AS as_of_date FROM orders) SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id CROSS JOIN clock c WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = '耳机' AND o.order_date >= c.as_of_date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND o.order_date < c.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day'
